subject: Data turnover cadence & handback safeguards for order form
messages:
From: Sam Hargrove <sam.h@moonlighthealth.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@moonlighthealth.com
Date: 2026-09-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Clarify data turnover cadence / deletion guarantees for order form

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for moving this forward. As we prepare the order form for signature, a couple of technical questions surfaced on our side around the bespoke retention windows and deletion timelines:

- The RFO draft mentions 'custom transient residency windows (14/30/90 days)'. Can you confirm whether we can lock to a single window (we'd prefer 30 days) at contract signing, and how that impacts snapshot/backup retention?
- If we choose accelerated deletion on termination, what are the practical steps and SLA for final wipe vs. cryptographic key destruction? Is there an option to certify deletion within 14 days in high-sensitivity workflows?
- Will Redwood provide a playbook describing the handback/evacuation runbook (log export, escrow snapshot, verification steps) we can attach to the SOW?

We're also looking for wording that maps to SOC 2 controls for data disposition — our legal team (cc'd) wants to avoid vague phrasing. If you have a short matrix (option -> impact on cost/availability/auditability) that would help us pick the right option quickly.

Appreciate a practical, implementation-focused answer so we can finalize procurement.

Best,
Sam
CTO, Moonlight Health
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: Sam Hargrove <sam.h@moonlighthealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify data turnover cadence / deletion guarantees for order form

Sam — thanks for the clear list. Happy to run through this and attach an operational playbook. Quick notes:

- You can lock a single transient residency window (we'll call it the 'Committed Window') on signature; that value will be enforced by the platform routing and eviction scheduler. Committing to 30 days is straightforward.
- Accelerated deletion options: we support two paths — logical deletion (fast, removes access + marks data for eviction) and cryptographic key destruction (fastest, renders data unrecoverable). We can commit to a 14-day certified deletion for Tier A data with the accelerated path; this requires a small addendum in the order form (see proposed clauses).
- We will provide a concise 'Handback & Evacuation Playbook' that lists step-by-step verification, export formats, and the audit artifacts we produce (md5 manifests, deletion certificates).

I'll pull together a short matrix (cost vs. availability vs. auditability) and attach the annotated SLA redlines + playbook draft. Can you confirm if Moonlight needs escrowed snapshots (we offer a 90-day escrow snapshot option at extra cost) or if you want to rely solely on standard backups?

I'll loop Grace and Tessa internally to finalize the wording. Expect a follow-up before EOD tomorrow.

— Jasmine
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-08T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Clarify data turnover cadence / deletion guarantees — draft replies + attachments

Grace / Tessa — dropping the ask below from Moonlight. Drafts attached: 'redwood-datapolicy-sla-redlines-annotated.docx' and 'moonlight-data-handback-playbook.pdf'. Key points I propose we offer:

1) Committed Window option: 14 / 30 / 90 days — customer picks at signing; default 30 if not specified.
2) Accelerated deletion SLA:
   - Logical purge: removal from live clusters and KV caches within 48 hours; full background eviction within 30 days.
   - Cryptographic key destruction: crypto-zeroize and certificate issuance within 14 days (requires HSM-backed KMS integration confirmation).
3) Escrow snapshot: optional 90-day snapshot retention in encrypted escrow repository; can be added to SOW at fixed fee.
4) Audit artifacts: MD5 manifests, deletion certificate, and a signed note from Redwood infra ops for each certified wipe.

Questions for you: any legal redline language you want pre-inserted? Also confirm estimated uplift on pricing for the 14-day certified crypto-destruct option (we should call out a modest one-time setup + 10% usage premium).

I'll incorporate your edits and share a customer-facing matrix (two-page) that maps choices to cost and auditability.

— Jas
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: Sam Hargrove <sam.h@moonlighthealth.com>
Cc: legal@moonlighthealth.com
Date: 2026-09-09T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed order-form language & playbook — Moonlight options (see attachments)

Hi Sam — attached are the two files I mentioned: 'redwood-datapolicy-sla-redlines-annotated.docx' (contains suggested order form clauses and the Committed Window checkbox) and 'moonlight-data-handback-playbook.pdf' (operational steps + artifacts). A brief summary of the options is below.

Committed Window: Customer chooses one at signature: 14 days | 30 days | 90 days. If unspecified, 30 days will apply.

Accelerated Deletion Paths:
- Logical Purge: immediate access revocation; background data eviction completed within customer-selected window. Deletion certificate provided upon completion.
- Crypto-Destruction (Certified 14-day option): Redwood destroys KMS keys (HSM-backed) and provides a signed crypto-destruction certificate within 14 days of request/termination. Requires a one-time KMS onboarding checklist and a setup fee (see annotated redlines).

Escrow Snapshot: Optional encrypted snapshot export to a mutually agreed escrow provider for up to 90 days; fees apply.

Attached are: 1) proposed clause text you can drop into the order form, 2) a three-row matrix mapping choice -> cost uplift -> audit footprint, and 3) the playbook with export & verification steps.

Next step: If you're comfortable with the language, we can have legal exchange a short addendum (DocuSign link below) and capture the Committed Window in the order form. I've also added the DocuSign envelope for the addendum here: https://app.docusign.com/embedded/1234567890

Let me know if you want to hop on a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk through the playbook.

Thanks — Jas
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-datapolicy-sla-redlines-annotated.docx (docx), moonlight-data-handback-playbook.pdf (pdf)
From: Sam Hargrove <sam.h@moonlighthealth.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@moonlighthealth.com
Date: 2026-09-10T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed order-form language & playbook — Moonlight options (see attachments)

Jas — this is very helpful, thank you. Legal reviewed the annotated redlines and the playbook looks solid. Two quick asks before we sign:

1) For the Committed Window, we'd like to lock to 30 days at signature (fine).
2) For the certified deletion option, legal prefers the wording to reference 'crypto-key destruction with third-party verification' rather than Redwood-only attestation. Could you add a short clause that allows for an independent verification, and we'll agree to the modest setup fee?

If you can insert that minor clarification into the addendum, we can sign the DocuSign envelope today. Otherwise, please confirm and I'll ask legal to sign.

Cheers,
Sam
CTO, Moonlight Health
